fix_applied: Replaced raw f-string SQL query using sqlalchemy text() (which interpolated user input directly into the SQL string) with a SQLAlchemy ORM filter using ilike() bound parameters in the /search endpoint handler. The vulnerable line `query = text(f"SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%{q}%' OR description LIKE '%{q}%'")` and `db.execute(query).fetchall()` were removed and replaced with `db.query(Product).filter(Product.name.ilike(f"%{q}%") | Product.description.ilike(f"%{q}%")).all()`, which passes the search term as a bound parameter rather than interpolating it into the SQL string.
verification_result: HTTP 200 OK. Response body contains: Search results for: "' OR 1=1--" — No products matched your search. We couldn't find any products matching "' OR 1=1--". The injection payload returned zero results instead of all products, confirming the fix is effective. Legitimate search (q=phone) continues to return 1 product(s) found.
